title: Singer and songwriter Lily Jay shares a new single "Scars"
htmlContent:
The outstanding female singer and songwriter Lily Jay returns with a new single called "SCARS," a song that displays a scars that she went through in her relationship. The single "Scars" is about a person who ended up a toxic relationship. The production is master class, that makes you listen repeatedly to catch each instrument, doing it’s work to the fullest as you enjoy the genre bending at a high level to make you enjoy the Pop and R&B touch to it that makes you want to high volume to the maximum.

Lily Jay’s “Scars” is that supreme level of music that gets the job done with sounds just right. The reasons to love this record is truly infinite, as each element come together to make one major great sound. The art of music is on full display for us all to see the scars, with a masterpiece being brought for us all to witness.
